unknownPolicy: signature-required; no inferred optional mode or guarded resume
signedPacket: Packet.signed_command; existing ECDSA-P256-SHA256 trust key; invalid signature always rejects
unsignedPacket: Packet.command with op_code=INIT and init; no signed_command

init.app_size: exact application.bin size, at most 69632 bytes

hostAdmission: Only exact 0xc1 permits unsigned before any destination write; never mark unsigned publisherVerified
